parts.name: rgb-window
parts.basis: RGB-marked carrier package in unchanged official dimension and exact-variant photographs; XY is photo registered. The 1.6x1.8x0.6mm package envelope is an explicit unmeasured rendering estimate, not native CAD.

derivedParts.basis: Published PCB outline;1.6mm thickness is an explicit unmeasured placeholder. The unknown rear remains marked UNKNOWN. Photo appearance is not native CAD or electrical layout.

dimensionTargets.scope: Manufacturer nominal outline; component stack and1.6mm assumed thickness excluded.

sourceSearch.scope: Official ESP32-DEV-KIT-XX resources, schematic and DemoTest archive inspected; no board STEP/KiCad or mechanical assembly found in these sources. No full unrelated repository-tree absence claimed.

pcb-main.uncertainty: Manual source board-edge registration; component height, parallax and source image resampling are not calibrated.

materialBasis: Manufacturer reference photographs guide approximate colors. Materials and undocumented package finishes are visualization only.
assemblyNotes: Millimetres; source geometry is retained without scaling. Source revisions, omitted members and estimated reconstruction boundaries are explicit.
limitations: No hardware-fit or browser/WebGL acceptance is implied by the retained CAD or CPU geometry checks.
Factory display execution is independently recorded in product limitations; a model screen only shows the actual emulator framebuffer.

Shared dimension photograph depicts WROVER-E. Its complete RF-module region is masked; exact variant photos drive distinct estimated module/antenna envelopes. No WROVER texture, label or capacity is transferred to WROOM/UE/IE.
Module package heights and rear component layout remain unmeasured. Front carrier section is source-photo appearance; unknown rear is labelled UNKNOWN.
Header variant has19pins/side at2.54mm pitch;0.6mm pin section and7mm length are estimates. Bare variants omit headers.
GPIO27 RGB index0 is mapped to the source-visible single carrier LED. Package dimensions/height and optical brightness remain estimated; no enclosure or cable mating acceptance.
